collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_astk_rly_296 --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_astk_rly_296_fl  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: ; HKV-RSTCAP fl1 10-19: closed r1 native capture rst_n 277.4 ps > 190 (the reset pin is the async clear of all 296 relay flops). Shared face landing standard (tools/ref_tile/face_land.py, spec face_land): top qkd_astk_rly_296_fl = generated wrapper, rst_n drives only ot_rst_relay (async assert, release +3 edges, zero steady-state cycles); core RTL unchanged.
